name: rosetta-set-puzzle
code:
use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

let colours = ["red", "green", "purple"]
let numbers = ["one", "two", "three"]
let symbols = ["oval", "squiggle", "diamond"]
let shadings = ["solid", "open", "striped"]

struct CARD(colour: int, number: int, symbol: int, shading: int) is
    to_string() -> string =>
        "{colours[colour]}, {numbers[number]}, "
        "{symbols[symbol]}, {shadings[shading]}"
si

use Triple = (CARD, CARD, CARD)

is_set(t: Triple) -> bool =>
    let (a, b, c) = t in
    (a.colour + b.colour + c.colour) % 3 == 0 /\
    (a.number + b.number + c.number) % 3 == 0 /\
    (a.symbol + b.symbol + c.symbol) % 3 == 0 /\
    (a.shading + b.shading + c.shading) % 3 == 0

triples(cards: List[CARD]) -> Pipe[Triple] is
    for i in 0..cards.count do
        for j in i + 1..cards.count do
            for k in j + 1..cards.count do
                yield (cards[i], cards[j], cards[k])
            od
        od
    od
si

let deck =
    (0..81)
        |> map(i => CARD(i % 3, i / 3 % 3, i / 9 % 3, i / 27))
        |> collect_list()

let random = System.Random(81)

deal(size: int) -> List[CARD] is
    for i in 0..size do
        let other = i + random.next(deck.count - i)
        let held = deck[i]

        deck[i] = deck[other]
        deck[other] = held
    od

    return deck |> take(size) |> collect_list()
si

puzzle(size: int, wanted: int) -> List[CARD] is
    do
        let cards = deal(size)

        if triples(cards) |> filter(is_set) |> count() == wanted then
            return cards
        fi
    od
si

let deals = [
    (mode = "basic", cards = puzzle(9, 4), wanted = 4),
    (mode = "advanced", cards = puzzle(12, 6), wanted = 6)
]

for (mode, cards, wanted) in deals do
    write_line("{mode}: dealt {cards.count} cards")

    for card in cards do
        write_line("    {card}")
    od

    write_line()
    write_line("containing {wanted} sets")

    for (a, b, c) in triples(cards) |> filter(is_set) do
        write_line()
        write_line("    {a}")
        write_line("    {b}")
        write_line("    {c}")
    od

    write_line()
od

let inks = [
    (220ub, 30ub, 50ub), (20ub, 150ub, 60ub), (110ub, 40ub, 150ub)]

outline(symbol: int, x: double, y: double)
        -> List[(x: double, y: double)] =>
    let steps = 32 in
    (0..steps)
        |> map(i =>
            let turn = cast double(i) / cast double(steps) in
            let t = 2.0D * Math.pi * turn in
            case symbol
            when 0 then
                (x = x + 8.0D * Math.cos(t), y = y + 18.0D * Math.sin(t))
            when 1 then
                let dy = 18.0D * Math.sin(t) in
                (x = x + 7.0D * Math.cos(t) + 4.0D * Math.sin(dy / 6.0D),
                 y = y + dy)
            else
                let s = Math.sin(t) in
                let c = Math.cos(t) in
                let k = 1.0D / (Math.abs(s) + Math.abs(c)) in
                (x = x + 9.0D * c * k, y = y + 19.0D * s * k)
            esac)
        |> collect_list()

let card_width = 120.0D
let card_height = 72.0D
let gap = 12.0D

let image = IMAGE(
    cast int(4.0D * card_width + 5.0D * gap),
    cast int(3.0D * card_height + 4.0D * gap))

image.view(
    0.0D, cast double(image.height), cast double(image.width), 0.0D)
image.clear(40ub, 90ub, 60ub)

for (card, place) in
        deals[1].cards |> index() |> map(iv => (iv.value, iv.index)) do
    let left = gap + cast double(place % 4) * (card_width + gap)
    let top = gap + cast double(place / 4) * (card_height + gap)
    let (red, green, blue) = inks[card.colour]

    image.colour(255ub, 255ub, 252ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(
        left, top, left + card_width, top + card_height)

    for i in 0..card.number + 1 do
        let offset = cast double(i) - cast double(card.number) / 2.0D
        let x = left + card_width / 2.0D + 26.0D * offset
        let shape = outline(card.symbol, x, top + card_height / 2.0D)

        if card.shading == 0 then
            image.colour(red, green, blue)
            image.fill(shape)
        elif card.shading == 2 then
            image.colour(
                cast ubyte(255 - (255 - cast int(red)) / 3),
                cast ubyte(255 - (255 - cast int(green)) / 3),
                cast ubyte(255 - (255 - cast int(blue)) / 3))
            image.fill(shape)
        fi

        image.colour(red, green, blue)
        image.stroke(2.0D)
        image.line(shape |> cat([shape[0]]) |> collect_list())
    od
od

image.write("set.png")

image.show("set.png")
